'''Mark Stephen Handcock''' is an Australian-American statistician. He is Distinguished Professor of Statistics at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mark S. Handcock – Data Theory at UCLA |url=https://datatheory.ucla.edu/person/mark-s-handcock/ |access-date=2026-07-20 |language=en-US}}</ref> His research focuses on statistical problems motivated by the social sciences, particularly statistical models for social networks, including exponential random graph models (ERGMs)<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Snijders |first1=Tom A. B. |last2=Pattison |first2=Philippa E. |last3=Robins |first3=Garry L. |last4=Handcock |first4=Mark S. |date=August 2006 |title=New Specifications for Exponential Random Graph Models |url=https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1467-9531.2006.00176.x |journal=Sociological Methodology |volume=36 |issue=1 |pages=99–153 |doi=10.1111/j.1467-9531.2006.00176.x |issn=0081-1750|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and latent space models,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Hoff |first1=Peter D |last2=Raftery |first2=Adrian E |last3=Handcock |first3=Mark S |date=December 2002 |title=Latent Space Approaches to Social Network Analysis |url=https://doi.org/10.1198/016214502388618906 |journal=Journal of the American Statistical Association |volume=97 |issue=460 |pages=1090–1098 |doi=10.1198/016214502388618906 |bibcode=2002JASA...97.1090H |issn=0162-1459|url-access=subscription }}</ref> as well as demography, spatial statistics,<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Handcock |first1=Mark S. |last2=Stein |first2=Michael L. |date=November 1993 |title=A Bayesian Analysis of Kriging |url=https://doi.org/10.1080/00401706.1993.10485354 |journal=Technometrics |volume=35 |issue=4 |pages=403–410 |doi=10.1080/00401706.1993.10485354 |issn=0040-1706|url-access=subscription }}</ref> social epidemiology,<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Miller |first=William C. |date=2004-05-12 |title=Prevalence of Chlamydial and Gonococcal Infections Among Young Adults in the United States |url=https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.291.18.2229 |journal=JAMA |volume=291 |issue=18 |pages=2229–2236 |doi=10.1001/jama.291.18.2229 |pmid=15138245 |issn=0098-7484|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and environmental statistics<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Fogt |first1=Ryan L. |last2=Sleinkofer |first2=Amanda M. |last3=Raphael |first3=Marilyn N. |last4=Handcock |first4=Mark S. |date=January 2022 |title=A regime shift in seasonal total Antarctic sea ice extent in the twentieth century |url=https://doi.org/10.1038/s41558-021-01254-9 |journal=Nature Climate Change |volume=12 |issue=1 |pages=54–62 |doi=10.1038/s41558-021-01254-9 |bibcode=2022NatCC..12...54F |issn=1758-678X}}</ref>
